request: Analyze GSE129612 for PMID 31393098 (Cell-specific ablation of Hsp47 defines the collagen-producing cells in the injured heart.): how exercise affects gene expression as the paper intends.

final.assay: bulk RNA-seq (NuGEN Ovation amplified, Nextera XT) of FACS-sorted EGFP+ cardiac myofibroblasts, HiSeq2500 (S4.12.p1)
final.sample_inclusion: EGFP+ myofibroblasts from Postn-MCM R26eGFP hearts 4 weeks after TAC, with (Hsp47fl/fl) or without Hsp47 deletion; n = 3 per group (S2.8.p2, FIG7 C-E)
final.primary_estimand: Effect of myofibroblast-specific Hsp47 deletion on gene expression of EGFP+ cardiac myofibroblasts after 4 weeks of TAC pressure overload (S2.8.p2). No exercise factor: all mice received TAC; treadmill running (S4.15.p1, FIG4 G) was only a functional test of Sgcd-null dystrophic mice and was not profiled.
planned_contrasts: Hsp47-deleted vs control EGFP+ myofibroblasts after TAC (S2.8.p2; paper reports no DEG count, only Supplemental Table 1 categories)
final.paper_method: AltAnalyze (Kallisto TPM, empirical Bayes moderated t-test) (S4.12.p1; GEO data_processing)

paper_threshold.source_locator: GEO data_processing (paper S4.12.p1 states no cutoff): moderated t p<0.05 non-adjusted with fold>2

final.paper_results: Up: Chad, Aspn, Tnmd, Fmod, Sdc4, Tgfb2, Furin, Cthrc1, Lox, Mmp3, Postn; down: Col1a1, Col3a1, Fn1, Fbn1, Adam12 (S2.8.p3, qPCR-confirmed). No DEG count reported.

paper_reconstruction.reasoning: The only RNA-seq in the paper (S4.12.p1, S2.8.p2) compares Hsp47-deleted with control myofibroblasts after TAC. Exercise appears only as a forced downhill treadmill performance test in dystrophic mice (S2.5.p1, S4.15.p1, FIG4 G), with no transcriptomic readout. The paper's estimand is genetic, not exercise.

checks: GEO samples are EGFP+ cardiac fibroblasts with Postn-MCM/R26eGFP and Hsp47-deficient genotypes, 3+3, matching FIG7 n = 3
matrix columns Con_HK3/Con_HK4/HK_2 and HSP47_1-3 match GEO titles

ownership.reasoning: Series, cell type, genotypes and n match the paper's profiling experiment.

grp: ^(Fibroblasts are CRE\+ and GFP\+|Fibroblasts are CRE\+, GFP\+, and HSP47-deficient)$

alignment.reasoning: Matrix sample columns are the part of the GEO title after 'runNNNN: '; exact match on that key. Genotype column gives CON (3) vs Hsp47 KO (3). The other matrix columns (avg, fold, rawp, adjp, ANOVA) are AltAnalyze statistics, not samples.

matrix.reasoning: GEO data_processing: Kallisto TPM summed to genes by AltAnalyze 2.1.2; AltAnalyze reports log2-scale expression with group averages and log_fold columns. Paper input is the same AltAnalyze output (S4.12.p1). Scale would route to limma; not executed because the design gate stops the case.

design.stop_reason: No exercise contrast: the profiled samples differ only by Hsp47 genotype (all after TAC, none exercised). The treadmill test in the paper (S4.15.p1) is a dystrophy performance readout with no RNA-seq. The data cannot identify an exercise effect on gene expression.

candidates.value: grp KO vs CON (Hsp47 deletion after TAC)
candidates.reason_rejected: Valid genetic contrast, but not the requested exercise estimand; running it would manufacture an exercise result.

design.reasoning: GEO metadata has a single varying factor, genotype (3 vs 3). No sample has an exercise, training or sedentary label, and the paper's only exercise procedure was not sequenced. Refused at design.

discrepancies.paper: RNA-seq estimand is Hsp47 deletion vs control after TAC; exercise only as treadmill performance in dystrophic mice
discrepancies.data: 6 samples, genotype only, no exercise arm
GEO titles show run1739 (2 controls) and run2675 (1 control + 3 KO); genotype partly confounded with run
